title: AI × Bio 每日精选
subtitle: 计算生物学、组学、蛋白质与生物医学模型。
method: 公开来源采集、历史去重、规则筛选与模型审阅
method_note: 系统保存当日公开元数据，与历史日报核验后排除已报道事件；论文新版本、新修订及不同软件发布等可核实更新仍可入选，随后由指定模型阅读全文摘要并完成精选。

items.title: Context-aware LLM extraction and controlled-vocabulary normalization of GEO transcriptomic sample metadata
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Motivation Public transcriptomic repositories contain millions of samples, but reuse is limited by inconsistent depositor-provided metadata. In the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO), biologically critical fields such as tissue, disease state and treatment are frequently encoded within heterogeneous free text descriptions, undefined abbreviations/acronyms, or implicit experimental context. Results We developed a locally deployable large language model (LLM) pipeline converting GEO sample metadata into structured Tissue, Condition and Treatment labels. It performs sample-level extraction (Phase 1), study-level contextual inference of missing labels from GSE context and sibling-sample label distributions (Phase 1b), and controlled-vocabulary entity-linking, also called concept normalization, to Medical Subject Headings (MeSH) and Cellosaurus cell-line identifiers (Phase 2), with out-of-vocabulary clustering for concepts not within these vocabularies. We evaluated 804,427 human GEO samples against other automated annotations and manually curated benchmarks for Tissue, Condition and Treatment. On the manual benchmark, the extractor labelled Tissue and Condition at 99.67% and 95.0% accuracy. Entity linking reached accuracies of 0.985, 0.993 and 0.982 (F1 = 0.993, 0.996 and 0.991) on the labels for which a controlled-vocabulary answer exists, and separately assigned an identifier at all to 80.69%, 62.91% and 23.13% of extracted labels against 31.68%, 35.01% and 7.46% for deterministic exact MeSH matching. Availability All code, evaluation and results are provided as Supplementary Data. An interactive program built from the pipeline is available at https://github.com/SciSpectator/LLM-GEO-Label-Extractor. Contact Jonathan-Wren@OMRF.org
items.summary_zh: 该研究以本地可部署LLM将GEO转录组样本的自由文本元数据转为标准化的组织、状态和处理标签，并在804,427个人类样本上评估。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 大规模、可复现的样本元数据规范化可显著提高公共转录组数据的可检索性和再利用价值。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要 研究动机 公共转录组数据库包含数百万样本，但不一致的提交者元数据限制了其再利用。在Gene Expression Omnibus（GEO）中，组织、疾病状态和处理等具有关键生物学意义的字段，常被编码在异质的自由文本描述、未定义的缩写/首字母缩略词或隐含的实验语境中。结果 我们开发了一条可在本地部署的large language model（LLM）流程，将GEO样本元数据转换为结构化的Tissue、Condition和Treatment标签。该流程执行样本层面的提取（Phase 1）、利用GSE语境和同胞样本标签分布对缺失标签进行研究层面的语境推断（Phase 1b），以及与Medical Subject Headings（MeSH）和Cellosaurus细胞系标识符进行受控词表实体链接（亦称概念规范化；Phase 2）；对于不在这些词表中的概念，则进行词表外聚类。我们在804,427个人类GEO样本上，相对于其他自动注释和人工整理基准评估了该流程的Tissue、Condition和Treatment标注。在人工基准上，提取器对Tissue和Condition的标注准确率分别为99.67%和95.0%。在存在受控词表答案的标签上，实体链接准确率分别达到0.985、0.993和0.982（F1分别为0.993、0.996和0.991）；另行考察是否为提取标签赋予了标识符时，其比例分别为80.69%、62.91%和23.13%，而确定性的精确MeSH匹配分别为31.68%、35.01%和7.46%。可用性 所有代码、评估和结果均作为Supplementary Data提供。基于该流程构建的交互式程序见https://github.com/SciSpectator/LLM-GEO-Label-Extractor。联系邮箱 Jonathan-Wren@OMRF.org

items.title: Clinical evaluation of artificial intelligence for diagnostics of antibiotic-resistant bacteria
items.abstract_or_text: Antimicrobial resistance is a public health challenge, driving the need for rapid, cost-effective diagnostic support tools. Artificial intelligence (AI) may enable prediction of susceptibility to untested antibiotics from known susceptibility results, but prospective clinical validation is required before routine use. We evaluated an AI-based decision support method, trained on invasive isolates from the European Surveillance System (TESSy), for prediction of antibiotic susceptibility in clinical Escherichia coli urine isolates. The evaluation included 99 E. coli isolates from urine samples with diversity in age, sex, and antibiotic susceptibility. Predictions were evaluated for 14 antibiotics using patient metadata and susceptibility results for 4-8 antibiotics as input. Prediction uncertainty was handled using conformal prediction, allowing abstention when confidence was insufficient. EUCAST disk diffusion test results were used as reference and genomic sequence data was used to explore mechanisms of the AI performance. Without conformal prediction, 84% of predictions were correct when susceptibility results of six antibiotics were used to predict susceptibility to eight additional antibiotics. Across all predictions generated using susceptibility results for six antibiotics as input, the major and very major error rates were 19% and 12%, respectively. Prediction errors varied between antibiotics and were associated with certain phenotypic and genotypic resistance patterns. Conformal prediction reduced errors but increased abstentions; at confidence levels of 90%, 95%, and 97.5%, the model abstained in 9.6%, 14%, and 22% of instances. The method showed promising performance, but its clinical use remains limited and may require diagnostic data beyond susceptibility test results and demographic variables.
items.summary_zh: 研究在99株临床尿液E. coli分离株上评估AI药敏预测，并量化保形预测在降低错误与增加拒答之间的权衡。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是小规模临床评估，直接显示模型在抗菌药物决策支持中仍存在不可忽略的重大和极重大错误。
items.abstract_zh: 抗微生物药物耐药性是一项公共卫生挑战，因而需要快速且成本效益高的诊断支持工具。人工智能（AI）或可利用已知药敏结果预测未经检测抗生素的敏感性，但在常规使用前需要前瞻性临床验证。我们评估了一种AI决策支持方法：该方法在European Surveillance System（TESSy）的侵袭性分离株上训练，用于预测临床Escherichia coli尿液分离株的抗生素敏感性。评估纳入99株来自尿液样本、在年龄、性别和抗生素敏感性方面具有多样性的E. coli分离株。以患者元数据和4–8种抗生素的药敏结果为输入，对14种抗生素进行预测。使用保形预测处理预测不确定性，在置信度不足时允许拒答。以EUCAST纸片扩散试验结果为参照，并利用基因组测序数据探索AI性能的机制。在未使用保形预测时，当以6种抗生素的药敏结果预测另外8种抗生素的敏感性，84%的预测正确。在以6种抗生素药敏结果为输入生成的全部预测中，重大错误率和极重大错误率分别为19%和12%。预测错误因抗生素而异，并与特定表型和基因型耐药模式相关。保形预测降低了错误，但增加了拒答；在90%、95%和97.5%的置信度下，模型分别在9.6%、14%和22%的实例中拒答。该方法显示出有前景的性能，但其临床使用仍受限，可能需要药敏试验结果和人口学变量以外的诊断数据。
items.author_line: Hessel, M., Inda Diaz, J. S., Sjöberg, A., Salva-Serra, F., Helldal, L., Jirstrand, M., Johnning, A., Kristiansson, E., Skovbjerg, S.

items.title: INTERVenE: Temporal-Abstraction-Interval Based Transformers for Short-Horizon Medical Event Prediction
items.abstract_or_text: Electronic Health Record (EHR) prediction models in the intensive care unit must learn from sparse and irregular measurements while preserving the clinical meaning of time and supporting transparent decision-making. We present INTERVenE, a family of Transformer architectures whose input is an interval-based, knowledge-based temporal abstraction (KBTA), a token stream of named clinical concepts (states, trends, events, contexts) drawn from a curated medical ontology, rather than an unnamed bin index or a raw measurement triplet. This naming layer is what we ask KBTA to do: it makes the model's per-token attributions resolve to clinical concepts by construction. INTERVenE offers two complementary variants: an auto-regressive decoder that generates future abstraction trajectories with a per-step risk readout (localizing when and after which events risk rises), and a bidirectional encoder for single-pass joint risk and time-to-event prediction. Evaluated on 57,078 MIMIC-IV admissions against GRU-D, STraTS, and KarmaLego, INTERVenE-Enc reaches a support-weighted AUPRC_w of 0.672, improving by 0.041 over the strongest neural baseline with non-overlapping 95\% bootstrap CIs, while also taking the best AUROC_w (0.901) and length-of-stay MAE (44.4\,h). INTERVenE-Ar (AUROC_w 0.854, AUPRC_w 0.587 under the same evaluation contract - a strictly harder generative readout) provides a complementary token-level risk trajectory. An input-representation ablation confirms the lift transfers across structured discretizations, positioning KBTA-based intervals as the interpretable substrate that makes per-token attributions resolve to meaningful clinical concepts within the deployed model.
items.summary_zh: INTERVenE将知识驱动的时间抽象区间编码为具名临床概念token，在57,078例MIMIC-IV住院记录上进行短期风险与事件时间预测。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把预测归因连接到可读的临床概念，同时提供与强基线的量化比较。
items.abstract_zh: 重症监护病房的电子健康记录（EHR）预测模型必须从稀疏且不规则的测量中学习，同时保留时间的临床意义并支持透明决策。我们提出INTERVenE：一组Transformer架构，其输入是基于区间、基于知识的时间抽象（KBTA），即来自经过整理的医学本体的具名临床概念（状态、趋势、事件、语境）token流，而非无名称的分箱索引或原始测量三元组。这一命名层正是我们要求KBTA完成的工作：它使模型的逐token归因在构造上解析为临床概念。INTERVenE提供两种互补变体：自回归解码器生成未来抽象轨迹并给出逐步风险读数（定位风险何时、在何种事件之后上升）；双向编码器则进行单次联合风险和事件时间预测。在57,078例MIMIC-IV住院记录上相对于GRU-D、STraTS和KarmaLego评估时，INTERVenE-Enc的支持度加权AUPRC_w为0.672，较最强神经网络基线提高0.041，且95% bootstrap CI不重叠；它还取得最佳AUROC_w（0.901）和住院时长MAE（44.4 h）。INTERVenE-Ar在相同评估约定下的AUROC_w为0.854、AUPRC_w为0.587（这一生成式读出严格来说更难），提供互补的token层面风险轨迹。对输入表示的消融证实，该提升可迁移至结构化离散化方案，表明基于KBTA的区间是一种可解释底座，使逐token归因在已部署模型中解析为具有意义的临床概念。

items.title: GPAgentBench-2K: Benchmarking Large Language Model Agents in Complex Clinical Action Space
items.abstract_or_text: Large Language Models (LLMs) show great potential as clinical agents, yet existing benchmarks reduce clinical workflows to static predictions or unconstrained Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) with coarse action sets. To address this, we introduce GPAgentBench-2K, the first Constrained MDP (CMDP) LLM-agent benchmark for primary-care clinical decision-making, constructed from expert-validated records of real-world GP encounters. Our environment models a full spectrum of six foundational clinical actions, imposes a topological workflow prior over the action space, and operationalizes safety-informed abstention as a first-class outcome. Evaluating 16 state-of-the-art LLMs reveals a significant performance degradation as the action space scales. Crucially, we uncover a clinical quality-safety gap: even frontier models with the highest diagnosis accuracy violate safety constraints in over half of high-risk cases. Finally, we establish a reference point using Constrained Group Relative Policy Optimization (C-GRPO), and show that while explicitly modeling constraints improves performance over unconstrained RL methods, it remains far from clinically acceptable safety.
items.summary_zh: GPAgentBench-2K以专家验证的真实全科就诊记录构建受约束MDP基准，评估16个LLM在复杂临床行动空间中的安全性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结果提示诊断准确率不能替代临床行动安全评估，适合作为医疗agent的严格测试资源。
items.abstract_zh: Large Language Models（LLMs）作为临床agent显示出巨大潜力，但现有基准将临床工作流简化为静态预测，或简化为行动集粗糙的无约束Markov Decision Processes（MDPs）。为解决这一问题，我们提出GPAgentBench-2K：首个用于基层医疗临床决策的受约束MDP（CMDP）LLM-agent基准，基于经专家验证的真实全科医生就诊记录构建。我们的环境模拟六类基础临床行动的完整范围，对行动空间施加拓扑工作流先验，并将知情安全的拒答作为一类一等结果。对16个最先进LLM的评估显示，随着行动空间扩大，性能显著下降。关键是，我们发现临床质量–安全差距：即使诊断准确率最高的前沿模型，在超过一半高风险病例中违反安全约束。最后，我们用Constrained Group Relative Policy Optimization（C-GRPO）建立参考点，显示显式建模约束虽能改善相对于无约束RL方法的性能，但距离临床可接受的安全水平仍很远。
items.author_line: Boqi Chen, Xudong Liu, Yunke Ao, Heejin Do, Jianing Qiu

items.title: Scalable Clinical Data Infrastructure and Comparative ML Evaluation for Hospitalisation Risk Prediction in Elderly Patients with Multiple Long-Term Conditions using CPRD
items.abstract_or_text: Deep learning architectures are increasingly proposed for patient trajectory modeling in electronic health records (EHRs), yet their advantage over simpler, more interpretable models is rarely subjected to rigorous empirical scrutiny in real-world clinical settings. We present a comprehensive patient timeline pipeline applied to elderly patients in CPRD Aurum, incorporating 260 clinical conditions classified via a three-tier automated framework including specialised detection logic for 17 complex conditions. Using this infrastructure, we benchmark Temporal Graph Convolutional Neural Networks (TG-CNN) against Logistic Regression with LASSO regularisation and Random Forests for predicting 12-month all-cause emergency hospitalisation risk, motivated by (but not filtered to) the elevated risk of adverse drug reactions. Under cross-validation, TG-CNN achieves a marginally higher mean AUC-ROC than LASSO (0.712 vs. 0.705), whereas on the held-out test set LASSO achieves the highest discrimination of three models (AUC-ROC 0.733, versus 0.710 for Random Forest and 0.702 for TG-CNN). We show, that discrimination alone is an incomplete criterion for clinical deployment: after Platt calibration, LASSO is the only model with an acceptable calibration slope (0.817), while Random Forest (0.759) and, TG-CNN (0.391) remain substantially miscalibrated. We argue that LASSO, not the highest-discriminating model, is the model best suited to direct clinical deployment. We present lessons for the machine learning and healthcare community regarding data infrastructure, model selection, and value of calibration and interpretability in high-stakes decision support.
items.summary_zh: 研究在CPRD Aurum老年多病共存人群中比较TG-CNN、LASSO和随机森林的12个月急诊住院风险预测及校准表现。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 真实临床数据上的留出集评估表明，复杂深度模型的表观优势未必转化为更适合临床使用的预测工具。
items.abstract_zh: 深度学习架构日益被用于电子健康记录（EHR）中的患者轨迹建模，但其相对更简单、更可解释模型的优势很少在真实临床环境中接受严格实证检验。我们提出一条综合患者时间线流程，并将其应用于CPRD Aurum中的老年多病共存患者；该流程纳入260种临床疾病，并采用三层自动化框架分类，其中包括针对17种复杂疾病的专门识别逻辑。借助这一基础设施，我们比较Temporal Graph Convolutional Neural Networks（TG-CNN）、带LASSO正则化的Logistic Regression和Random Forests，以预测12个月全因紧急住院风险；研究动机与不良药物反应的升高风险有关，但并未按此筛选。在交叉验证中，TG-CNN的平均AUC-ROC略高于LASSO（0.712对0.705）；但在留出的测试集上，LASSO在三种模型中判别力最高（AUC-ROC 0.733，而Random Forest为0.710、TG-CNN为0.702）。我们表明，仅凭判别力不足以作为临床部署标准：经Platt校准后，只有LASSO具有可接受的校准斜率（0.817），Random Forest（0.759）和TG-CNN（0.391）仍明显失校准。我们认为，LASSO而非判别力最高的模型，最适合直接临床部署。我们为机器学习和医疗保健界提供了有关数据基础设施、模型选择，以及校准和可解释性在高风险决策支持中价值的经验。
items.author_line: Asra Aslam, Volodymyr Chapman, Maurice M. O'Connell, Aseel S. Abuzour, Michael Abaho, Danushka Bollegala, Gary Leeming, Eduard Shantsila, Andrew Clegg, Lauren E. Walker, Iain Edward Buchan, Samuel D. Relton

items.title: Do Pathology Foundation Models Learn Biology? Uncertainty-Based Evaluation on AML Cytomorphology
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Pathology foundation models are increasingly deployed as feature extractors for medical image analysis, yet their advantage over general-purpose vision models in unsupervised settings has not been directly tested. We held the clustering pipeline fixed and varied only the backbone across three pretraining regimes on the AML-Cytomorphology LMU dataset (17,447 single-c cell types): ResNet50 (supervised, ImageNet), DINOv2-large (self-supervised, natural images), and Virchow2 (self-supervised, 3.1 million pathology whole-slide images). Per-cell uncertainty scores served as a probe of biological structure. Virchow2 uncertainty differed substantially across cell types (Kruskal-Wallis H = 178.2, p = 1.5 × 10 −30 ), with transitional myeloid precursors showing higher uncertainty than mature stable types (Ω¯ = 0.384 vs. 0.313, p = 4.3 × 10 −15 ). DINOv2 and ResNet50 showed no such pattern. DINOv2 ranked first on all internal clustering metrics (Silhouette=0.522) yet last on biological recovery (ARI=0.033); Virchow2 showed the inverse ordering. Across five seeds, Virchow2 clustering accuracy fluctuated widely (ARI=0.016 ± 0.006) while its uncertainty structure remained stable, identifying uncertainty as the more reliable signal of representation quality.
items.summary_zh: 该研究固定聚类流程，仅替换视觉骨干网络，并用细胞不确定性检验病理基础模型是否恢复AML细胞形态学的生物结构。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它指出内部聚类指标与生物学恢复能力可能脱钩，为病理基础模型评估提供了更谨慎的视角。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要 病理基础模型日益被部署为医学图像分析的特征提取器，但其相较通用视觉模型在无监督场景中的优势尚未被直接检验。我们固定聚类流程，仅改变三个预训练方案中的骨干网络：ResNet50（监督式，ImageNet）、DINOv2-large（自监督，自然图像）和Virchow2（自监督，310万张病理全切片图像），并在AML-Cytomorphology LMU数据集（17,447个单细胞）上比较。每个细胞的不确定性分数被用作生物结构的探针。Virchow2的不确定性在不同细胞类型间存在显著差异（Kruskal-Wallis H = 178.2，p = 1.5 × 10−30）；过渡性髓系前体的不确定性高于成熟稳定类型（Ω¯ = 0.384对0.313，p = 4.3 × 10−15）。DINOv2和ResNet50未表现出这一模式。DINOv2在所有内部聚类指标上均居首（Silhouette = 0.522），但在生物学恢复上居末（ARI = 0.033）；Virchow2的排序则相反。在五个随机种子中，Virchow2的聚类准确率波动很大（ARI = 0.016 ± 0.006），但其不确定性结构保持稳定，表明不确定性是表征质量更可靠的信号。
items.author_line: Bhat A, Kawa S, Munzir M

items.title: En-ViMedNER: An English-Vietnamese Parallel Biomedical Corpus with UMLS Semantic Type Annotations
items.abstract_or_text: Biomedical Named Entity Recognition (NER) is fundamental to healthcare AI applications, including clinical decision support and medical information extraction. While corpora with Unified Medical Language System (UMLS) annotations, such as MedMentions, have driven progress in English biomedical NER, no comparable resource exists for Vietnamese. This paper presents En-ViMedNER, the first English-Vietnamese parallel biomedical NER corpus annotated with UMLS semantic types, which are language-neutral codes providing a shared cross-lingual label space and ensuring direct comparability with existing UMLS-based resources. The corpus contains 4,392 PubMed abstract pairs, 44,892 English-Vietnamese sentence pairs, and 202,949 aligned entity-mention pairs across 21 semantic types adapted from the MedMentions ST21pv dataset. To balance quality and scalability, we have constructed the corpus through automatic translation, expert post-editing, LLM-assisted label projection, and human verification and adjudication. We characterize En-ViMedNER as a large-scale silver-standard corpus with a human-audited and consensus-corrected mini-test subset. We evaluate En-ViMedNER in two settings: (i) Vietnamese-input/Vietnamese-output biomedical NER and (ii) English-input/Vietnamese-output cross-lingual NER. For Vietnamese NER, we benchmark Vietnamese-supervised encoder models, English-supervised multilingual encoder models, and prompt-based LLMs. The best model achieves an F1 score of 52.70 on the test set and 53.78 on the mini-test set. For cross-lingual NER, we benchmark encoder-decoder models and prompt-based LLMs. The best model achieves an F1 score of 45.44 on the mini-test set. We publicly release our corpus, corpus construction pipeline, and baseline models to facilitate future Vietnamese biomedical NLP research.
items.summary_zh: En-ViMedNER发布英越平行生物医学NER语料，覆盖202,949个对齐实体提及及21类UMLS语义类型。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 公开的跨语言语料、构建流程和基线模型可补足越南语生物医学NLP资源缺口。
items.abstract_zh: 生物医学命名实体识别（NER）是医疗AI应用的基础，包括临床决策支持和医学信息提取。带有Unified Medical Language System（UMLS）注释的语料库，如MedMentions，已推动英语生物医学NER进展，但越南语尚无可比资源。本文提出En-ViMedNER：首个使用UMLS语义类型标注的英越平行生物医学NER语料库。这些类型是语言无关的代码，提供共享的跨语言标签空间，并确保可与现有的UMLS资源直接比较。该语料库包含4,392对PubMed摘要、44,892对英越句子，以及202,949对跨21种语义类型的对齐实体提及；语义类型由MedMentions ST21pv数据集调整而来。为平衡质量与可扩展性，我们通过自动翻译、专家后编辑、LLM辅助标签投射，以及人工核验和裁决构建语料。我们将En-ViMedNER描述为大规模银标准语料，并配有经人工审计和共识修正的小型测试子集。我们在两种设置下评估En-ViMedNER：（i）越南语输入/越南语输出的生物医学NER；（ii）英语输入/越南语输出的跨语言NER。对于越南语NER，我们基准测试了以越南语监督的编码器模型、以英语监督的多语言编码器模型和提示式LLM。最佳模型在测试集上的F1为52.70，在小型测试集上的F1为53.78。对于跨语言NER，我们基准测试了编码器–解码器模型和提示式LLM。最佳模型在小型测试集上的F1为45.44。我们公开发布语料库、语料构建流程和基线模型，以促进未来越南语生物医学NLP研究。
items.author_line: Nhu Vo, Phuong Nguyen, Nu Uyen Phuong Le, Inigo Jauregi Unanue, Dung D. Le, Massimo Piccardi, Wray Buntine

items.title: A Visually Interpretable Histopathology-Based Immune Model Predicts T-effector Biology and Response to Immune checkpoint inhibition in Clear Cell Renal Cell Carcinoma Clinical Trial and Contemporary Real-World Datasets
items.abstract_or_text: Immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICI) are central to the treatment of metastatic clear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC), yet only a subset of patients derive durable benefit, and clinically deployable predictive biomarkers remain an unmet need. RNA-based T-effector signatures capture cytotoxic immune biology and have been associated with ICI response in clinical trial cohorts; however, their clinical implementation is limited by the marked spatial heterogeneity of ccRCC, as well as cost, long turnaround time, sample quality requirements, and limited accessibility. Here, we developed a visually interpretable deep learning (DL) model that predicts a T-cell-enriched immune score directly from hematoxylin and eosin (H&E)-stained whole-slide images. To overcome the inability of H&E morphology alone to distinguish lymphocyte subsets, we trained the model using multimodal spatial supervision from CD8, PAX8, and ERG IHC, which respectively identified cytotoxic T-cell-rich regions, tumor cells, and endothelial cells, thereby constraining immune predictions to relevant tumor microenvironmental niches. The resulting H&E DL Immune score was validated by pathologist review, comparison with held-out CD8 IHC annotations, and independent datasets. The H&E DL Immune score correlated with T-effector RNA scores across independent institutional and IMmotion150 clinical trial cohorts (spearman correlations of 0.726; p=5.90x10-15 and 0.706; p=4.04x10-19). As a proof of principle, the score was used to characterize associations with key biological features across large cohorts, including sarcomatoid differentiation, BAP1 and PBRM1 mutation status, and additional transcriptomic signatures. In IMmotion150 clinical trial cohort, a median-dichotomized H&E DL Immune score, similar to RNA-based T-effector score, was significantly associated with clinical benefit from atezulumab therapy. In contemporary institutional cohorts of patients treated with frontline ipilimumab plus nivolumab or in initial 3 lines of nivolumab monotherapy, patients in the top quartile of H&E DL Immune score had significantly longer progression-free survival. Collectively, these findings support a scalable and interpretable H&E-based biomarker that captures T-effector biology and can help identify patients with ccRCC more likely to benefit from ICIs.
items.summary_zh: 研究以多模态空间监督训练可解释H&E深度学习模型，预测ccRCC的T-effector免疫评分，并在临床试验和机构队列中检验其关联。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作把常规病理切片与免疫治疗相关生物学相连，但作为预印本，其预测性生物标志物仍需前瞻性验证。
items.abstract_zh: Immune checkpoint inhibitors（ICI）是转移性透明细胞肾细胞癌（ccRCC）治疗的核心，但只有部分患者获得持久获益，临床可部署的预测生物标志物仍未得到满足。基于RNA的T-effector特征可捕捉细胞毒性免疫生物学，并在临床试验队列中与ICI应答相关；然而，ccRCC显著的空间异质性，以及成本高、周转时间长、样本质量要求和可及性受限，限制了其临床实施。我们在此开发了一种视觉上可解释的深度学习（DL）模型，可直接从苏木精–伊红（H&E）染色全切片图像预测富含T细胞的免疫评分。为克服仅靠H&E形态学无法区分淋巴细胞亚群的问题，我们利用CD8、PAX8和ERG IHC提供多模态空间监督训练模型；它们分别识别富含细胞毒性T细胞的区域、肿瘤细胞和内皮细胞，从而将免疫预测限定于相关的肿瘤微环境生态位。所得H&E DL Immune评分通过病理学家审阅、与留出CD8 IHC注释比较及独立数据集得到验证。H&E DL Immune评分与独立机构队列和IMmotion150临床试验队列中的T-effector RNA评分相关（Spearman相关系数分别为0.726，p = 5.90×10−15；和0.706，p = 4.04×10−19）。作为概念验证，该评分被用于描述大型队列中与关键生物学特征的关联，包括肉瘤样分化、BAP1和PBRM1突变状态以及其他转录组特征。在IMmotion150临床试验队列中，按中位数二分的H&E DL Immune评分与RNA T-effector评分相似，均与atezolizumab治疗的临床获益显著相关。在接受一线ipilimumab加nivolumab治疗，或接受nivolumab单药初始3线治疗的当代机构队列中，H&E DL Immune评分位于最高四分位数的患者具有显著更长的无进展生存期。总体而言，这些发现支持一种可扩展、可解释的H&E生物标志物；它可捕捉T-effector生物学，并可帮助识别更可能从ICI获益的ccRCC患者。
items.author_line: Perny, A., Jarmale, V., Jasti, J., Zhong, H., Christie, A. L., Miyata, J., Nielsen, A. W., Kontoyiannis, P., Rakheja, D., Modrusan, Z., Huseni, M., Kadel, W., Brugarolas, J., Kapur, P., Rajaram, S.

items.title: RECON infers regions of interest from H&E images and reconstructs whole-slide molecular profiles at single-cell resolution
items.abstract_or_text: Spatial omics technologies resolve molecular expression and spatial architecture at single-cell resolution, but profiling whole slides remains costly. In practice, only a few regions of interest (ROIs) are profiled, leaving the rest of the tissue unmeasured. S2-omics was the first framework to unify ROI selection with out-of-ROI prediction, but it operates on superpixels rather than individual cells and predicts discrete cell types rather than continuous molecular profiles. Superpixel-based representations do not explicitly preserve cell boundaries, while categorical cell-type labels cannot quantify molecular expression within cells. Here we present RECON, a two-stage framework that performs ROI inference and whole-slide molecular reconstruction at single-cell resolution, predicting both continuous molecular profiles and discrete cell-type labels. In the first stage, RECON extracts morphological and microenvironmental features from individual cells to identify a representative ROI for spatially resolved single-cell molecular profiling. In the second stage, RECON trains deep learning models on molecular measurements acquired within the selected ROI and reconstructs transcriptomic or proteomic profiles for all remaining cells on the slide. Benchmarked against pathologist annotations, RECONs ROI selection outperforms the superpixel-based S2-omics approaches (IoU: 0.75 versus 0.64). For transcriptomics, refining the modeling unit from superpixels to single cells improves per-gene Pearson correlation by 22%. For proteomics, RECON surpasses the current state-of-the-art method, ROSIE, across all 16 markers, with a median per-cell Pearson correlation of 0.91 versus 0.84. Moreover, RECON delineates tumour boundaries and regions with distinct immune-cell densities, and highlights candidate tertiary lymphoid structures. Together, these results demonstrate that RECON enables informative ROI selection and whole-slide molecular reconstruction at single-cell resolution for both spatial transcriptomics and spatial proteomics.
items.summary_zh: RECON从H&E图像选择代表性ROI，并以单细胞尺度重建全切片转录组或蛋白组图谱。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该方法针对空间组学的测量成本问题，在ROI选择与切片外分子预测上均给出了定量对比。
items.abstract_zh: 空间组学技术能以单细胞分辨率解析分子表达和空间结构，但对整张切片进行分析的成本仍很高。在实践中，通常只对少数感兴趣区域（ROIs）进行分析，使其余组织未被测量。S2-omics是首个将ROI选择与ROI外预测统一的框架，但它在超像素而非单个细胞上运行，且预测离散细胞类型而非连续分子图谱。基于超像素的表示并不明确保留细胞轮廓，而类别型细胞类型标签无法量化细胞内的分子表达。我们在此提出RECON：一个两阶段框架，以单细胞分辨率进行ROI推断和全切片分子重建，同时预测连续分子图谱和离散细胞类型标签。在第一阶段，RECON从单个细胞提取形态和微环境特征，以识别用于空间分辨单细胞分子分析的代表性ROI。在第二阶段，RECON在选定ROI内获取的分子测量上训练深度学习模型，并为切片中其余全部细胞重建转录组或蛋白组图谱。相对于病理学家注释的基准比较显示，RECON的ROI选择优于基于超像素的S2-omics方法（IoU：0.75对0.64）。对于转录组，将建模单元从超像素细化为单个细胞，使逐基因Pearson相关提高22%。对于蛋白组，RECON在全部16个标记物上超过当前最先进方法ROSIE，逐细胞Pearson相关的中位数为0.91，对比0.84。此外，RECON划出了肿瘤轮廓和具有不同免疫细胞密度的区域，并凸显候选三级淋巴结构。总之，这些结果表明，RECON可为转录组和蛋白组提供信息丰富的ROI选择及单细胞分辨率全切片分子重建。
items.author_line: Yang, X., Hao, N., Zhao, R., Angel, S., Tan, Y., Lian, C. G., Zhou, L., Olson, D., Yu, K.-H., Ruiz de Luzuriaga, A., Wan, G.

items.title: A Multi-Agent Large Language Model Reasoning Engine for Early Detection of Pediatric Growth Disorders
items.abstract_or_text: Routine childhood growth surveillance is a cornerstone of pediatric care. Growth pattern abnormalities are often early manifestations of chronic disease. Yet subtle abnormalities are frequently underrecognized, leading to diagnostic delays and avoidable morbidity. We introduce SPROUT (System for Pediatric Recognition Of Undiagnosed Trajectories), a generalized, multi-agent large language model (LLM) reasoning system designed to identify a broad spectrum of pediatric growth-related conditions from longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs) earlier than standard clinical practice. Using a large pediatric primary care EHR dataset, we developed and validated SPROUT as a two-stage system. First, a highly specific LLM screener flags concerning longitudinal growth patterns. Second, an Orchestrator module coordinates a multidisciplinary panel of LLM agents to generate a ranked differential diagnosis. To correct systemic reasoning errors, a Trainer module injects meta-knowledge into the panel via a dedicated "Learner" agent. Diagnostic capability was evaluated using a walk-forward, visit-by-visit simulation leading up to the diagnosis date. The SPROUT screener model achieved 98% (83/85) specificity and 28% (9/32) sensitivity on a gold-standard dataset of pediatric primary care patients when evaluated one year before the index date, and 100% specificity and 47% sensitivity when evaluated using longitudinal data up to the day of diagnosis. When applied to 300 control patients (i.e., healthy or undiagnosed), the screener flagged 15. Subsequent expert panel review confirmed high suspicion for undiagnosed pathology in 33% (5/15) of these cases. In chronological walk-forward validation on disease cases, the diagnostic engine identified conditions well before standard-of-care documentation. One year prior to clinical diagnosis, the system achieved sensitivities of 81% for type 1 diabetes mellitus, 56% for pituitary disorders, and 44% for celiac disease. The SPROUT multi-agent system demonstrates the ability to detect a significant portion of latent growth-related pediatric conditions months to years before current clinical standards while minimizing false positives. These results support its potential as a decision support tool for reducing diagnostic delays in pediatric care.
items.summary_zh: SPROUT以两阶段多agent LLM分析纵向儿科EHR，在逐次就诊模拟中识别生长异常相关疾病。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它提供了早期识别的临床数据证据，但金标准样本规模有限，尚不能支持常规临床使用。
items.abstract_zh: 常规儿童生长监测是儿科医疗的基石。生长模式异常常是慢性疾病的早期表现，但细微异常经常未被识别，导致诊断延迟和可避免的发病。我们提出SPROUT（System for Pediatric Recognition Of Undiagnosed Trajectories）：一个通用的多agent large language model（LLM）推理系统，旨在从纵向电子健康记录（EHR）中较标准临床实践更早识别广谱儿科生长相关疾病。我们利用大型儿科基层医疗EHR数据集，开发并验证了SPROUT这一两阶段系统。第一阶段，高特异性LLM筛查器标记令人担忧的纵向生长模式。第二阶段，Orchestrator模块协调一个多学科LLM agent小组，生成排序后的鉴别诊断。为纠正系统性推理错误，Trainer模块经由专门的“Learner” agent向该小组注入元知识。我们采用截至诊断日期之前、按每次就诊递进的模拟评估诊断能力。在诊断日前一年评估时，SPROUT筛查模型在儿科基层医疗患者金标准数据集上取得98%（83/85）的特异度和28%（9/32）的敏感度；使用截至诊断当日的纵向数据评估时，特异度为100%、敏感度为47%。应用于300名对照患者（即健康或未诊断患者）时，筛查器标记了15名；后续专家小组审阅确认其中33%（5/15）病例高度疑似存在未诊断病理。对疾病病例进行按时间顺序的递进验证时，诊断引擎早于标准医疗记录识别出疾病。在临床诊断前一年，系统对1型糖尿病、垂体疾病和乳糜泻的敏感度分别为81%、56%和44%。SPROUT多agent系统显示出在减少假阳性的同时，于当前临床标准之前数月至数年识别相当一部分潜在生长相关儿科疾病的能力。这些结果支持其作为减少儿科诊断延迟的决策支持工具的潜力。
items.author_line: Rabbani, N., Mettner, J., Lee, K., Soto-Rivera, C. L., Windberger, A., Santiago, K., Hatoun, J., Correa, E. T., Vernacchio, L., Kohane, I.

items.title: Half of alcohol, drug, and self-harm presentations cannot be identified in coded emergency department data: a diagnostic accuracy study of a large language model
items.abstract_or_text: Objective To measure the accuracy of clinical coding, clinician review, and a locally deployed large language model (LLM) in identifying alcohol, drug, and self-harm involvement in emergency department (ED) attendances, and quantify prevalence. Design Two-phase diagnostic accuracy study. In a validation week, the identification strategies were assessed against a conflict-adjudicated reference standard (n=2,256); the LLM was then applied to n=105,096 annual attendances at the same site. Setting UK Type 1 Emergency Department treating patients [≥]16yrs. Main outcome measures Prevalence quantification compared with the reference standard; sensitivity, specificity, and balanced accuracy of each strategy; monthly identification rates and adjusted annual prevalence. Results The reference standard identified 12.1% of attendances as involving alcohol, drugs, or self-harm (coding 6.0%; clinician 10.0%, LLM 15.6%). LLM balanced accuracy matched or outperformed clinician review in all three domains (alcohol 0.942 v 0.930, p=0.635; drug 0.959 v 0.791, p<0.001; self-harm 0.982 v 0.908, p=0.004). Coding recorded 1.07 domains per identified patient against 1.32 in the reference standard. Adjusted annual prevalence corresponded to 12,890 domain involvements per year not identifiable in coded data. Subdomain classification found at least 81.6% of self-harm attendances required medical assessment for injury or overdose before psychiatric review. Conclusions Clinical coding identified fewer than half of presentations involving alcohol, drugs, and self-harm and rarely captured co-occurring domains; under-recording was present across a full year. A locally deployed LLM generated more complete structured data from existing clinical text within NHS infrastructure, at a scale which is not feasible for manual review.
items.summary_zh: 一项两阶段诊断准确性研究比较临床编码、人工审阅和本地LLM对急诊酒精、药物和自伤就诊的识别能力。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在单一NHS急诊场景中，LLM从既有临床文本中补全结构化信息；其外部可推广性和实际部署影响仍待检验。
items.abstract_zh: 目的 测量临床编码、临床医生审阅和本地部署large language model（LLM）在识别急诊（ED）就诊中酒精、药物和自伤涉入方面的准确性，并量化其患病率。设计 两阶段诊断准确性研究。在验证周中，针对经争议裁决的参照标准（n = 2,256）评估这些识别策略；随后将LLM应用于同一地点全年n = 105,096次就诊。地点 英国Type 1 Emergency Department，收治年龄[≥]16岁的患者。主要结局指标 与参照标准比较的患病率量化；各策略的敏感度、特异度和均衡准确率；月度识别率和校正后的年度患病率。结果 参照标准识别12.1%的就诊涉及酒精、药物或自伤（编码6.0%；临床医生10.0%；LLM 15.6%）。LLM在全部三个领域的均衡准确率与临床医生审阅相当或更高（酒精0.942对0.930，p = 0.635；药物0.959对0.791，p < 0.001；自伤0.982对0.908，p = 0.004）。对于每名被识别患者，编码记录1.07个领域，而参照标准记录1.32个领域。校正后的年度患病率对应于每年12,890个无法在编码数据中识别的领域涉入。亚领域分类发现，至少81.6%的自伤就诊需要先对损伤或过量服药进行医学评估，再进行精神科审阅。结论 临床编码识别出的酒精、药物和自伤相关就诊不足一半，且很少捕捉共现领域；全年均存在少记。本地部署LLM可在NHS基础设施内，从既有临床文本生成更完整的结构化数据，且达到人工审阅无法实现的规模。
items.author_line: Humphries, C., Brett, J., Gruber, F., James, E., McKendrick, T. I., McNairn, K. C., Miell, A., O'Brien, R., Rahman, F., Schölin, L., Stewart, M., Casey, A.

items.title: Accurate detection of metagenomic strain-level associations using average nucleotide identity with StrainSpy
items.abstract_or_text: Genetic variation among microbial strains of the same species can profoundly influence their phenotypes, ecological functions, and impacts on human health. Traditionally, the relative abundance of a species has been used to identify associations between the microbiome and disease. However, this approach overlooks intra-species genetic variation and is susceptible to spurious correlations arising from the compositional nature of abundance data and microbial load. Fast, k-mer-based algorithms can now accurately estimate strain-level Average Nucleotide Identity (ANI) in metagenomes. Despite its value as an orthogonal metric for strain-level analysis, methods for conducting ANI-based association studies remain limited. To address this, we developed StrainSpy, a statistical algorithm that identifies associations between containment ANI and variables of interest across a wide range of study designs, including longitudinal and multi-cohort designs. Re-analysis of a study examining gut microbiota recovery in 12 healthy adults following antibiotic exposure revealed novel strain-level associations, including a reduction in strain-level diversity despite species persistence. Applying StrainSpy to a multi-cohort analysis of 3,414 colorectal cancer metagenomes identified novel strain-level associations with colorectal cancer. However, in a separate collection of microbiome-immunotherapy studies, no individual strain was consistently associated across cohorts. Importantly, across both datasets, StrainSpy informed containment ANI-based machine learning models achieved comparable accuracy to traditional abundance-based methods. StrainSpy is publicly available as an R package github.com/gtonkinhill/strainspy.
items.summary_zh: StrainSpy以宏基因组平均核苷酸一致性识别菌株层面的关联，并在抗生素暴露、结直肠癌和免疫治疗队列中再分析。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 方法和R包将菌种内遗传差异纳入关联研究，并在多队列中避免把未复现的关联夸大为发现。
items.abstract_zh: 同一物种内微生物菌株之间的遗传变异可深刻影响其表型、生态功能及其对人类健康的影响。传统上，研究以物种相对丰度识别微生物组与疾病的关联，但这一方法忽视种内遗传变异，且容易受到丰度数据组成性和微生物负荷所致伪相关的影响。快速、基于k-mer的算法现可在宏基因组中准确估计菌株层面的Average Nucleotide Identity（ANI）。尽管它是菌株层面分析的一项正交指标，开展基于ANI的关联研究的方法仍有限。为此，我们开发StrainSpy：一种统计学算法，可在包括纵向和多队列设计在内的广泛研究设计中，识别containment ANI与关注变量之间的关联。对一项抗生素暴露后12名健康成人肠道微生物组恢复研究的再分析，发现了新的菌株层面关联，包括在物种持续存在时菌株层面多样性下降。将StrainSpy应用于3,414份结直肠癌宏基因组的多队列分析，识别出与结直肠癌相关的新菌株层面关联。然而，在另一组微生物组–免疫治疗研究中，没有单一菌株能在各队列间保持一致关联。重要的是，在两类数据集上，StrainSpy信息支持的containment ANI机器学习模型均达到与传统丰度方法相当的准确性。StrainSpy以R package形式公开，地址为github.com/gtonkinhill/strainspy。
items.author_line: Mallawaarachchi, S., Tandon, K., Rajan, N., Marcelino, V. R., Sandhu, S., Bedoui, S., Ingle, D. J., Gunjur, A., Tonkin-Hill, G.

items.title: Design and characterization of broadly protective influenza A(H3N2) vaccine candidates using protein language models
items.abstract_or_text: Seasonal influenza A viruses cause significant global morbidity each year. Although vaccination remains the primary preventive strategy, effectiveness is often reduced by antigenic drift. This challenge is particularly pronounced for influenza A(H3N2), which has required eight vaccine updates over the past decade. Here, we present a computational framework to engineer broadly reactive influenza A(H3N2) vaccines, using protein language models to generate novel hemagglutinin (HA) sequences and a machine learning model to predict antigenic distance from circulating strains. In a proof-of-concept study, seven HA candidates designed using sequence data from 2013-2018 were evaluated in mice against contemporary and subsequently circulating viruses. Two candidates elicited protective levels of reactive antibodies, robust H3-specific antibody-secreting cell responses, and cross-neutralization against contemporary clades and drifted 2019-2020 strains. These findings demonstrate that an integrated generation-selection strategy can enhance vaccine coverage across current and future A(H3N2) seasons and may be applicable to other influenza subtypes.
items.summary_zh: 研究利用蛋白质语言模型生成H3N2血凝素序列并预测抗原距离，在小鼠中表征7个候选疫苗。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 计算生成与动物实验结合，为广谱流感疫苗设计提供了初步证据，但尚非人体有效性证据。
items.abstract_zh: 季节性influenza A病毒每年造成显著的全球疾病负担。尽管疫苗接种仍是主要预防策略，抗原漂移常使疫苗效力降低。对于influenza A(H3N2)，这一挑战尤为突出：过去十年中已进行八次疫苗更新。我们在此提出一个计算框架，用蛋白质语言模型生成新的血凝素（HA）序列，并用机器学习模型预测与流行毒株的抗原距离，以工程化获得广泛反应性的influenza A(H3N2)疫苗。在概念验证研究中，我们使用2013–2018年的序列数据设计7个HA候选物，并在小鼠中针对当代和随后流行的病毒进行评估。两个候选物诱导了具有保护水平的反应性抗体、强健的H3特异性抗体分泌细胞应答，以及针对当代分支和漂移的2019–2020毒株的交叉中和。这些发现表明，一体化的生成–筛选策略可增强当前及未来A(H3N2)季节的疫苗覆盖，并可能适用于其他流感亚型。
items.author_line: Howard, V. R., Allen, J. D., Thomas, M. H., Sautto, G. A., Ross, T. M., Georgiev, I. S.

items.title: PhageTAILor leverages machine learning for phage tail-like elements detection and classification in plant-associated bacteria
items.abstract_or_text: Phage tail-like elements (PTEs) -- tailocins, bacterial type VI secretion systems (T6SS), and extracellular contractile injection systems (eCIS) -- are contractile nanomachines that bacteria use to kill their neighbors and compete within their micro-ecosystems. PTEs help shape microbial community composition. Most PTE detection tools only detect a single PTE class. Moreover, most tailocin detection methods are largely restricted to Pseudomonas, leaving a key part of tailocin diversity uncharacterized. In this work, we present PhageTAILor (https://github.com/hjcho-bio/PhageTAILor), an integrative and fully automated pipeline that detects and classifies prophages and 3 PTE classes from bacterial genomes. PhageTAILor combines a 6-detector homology-based candidate search (geNomad, tail-gene, PHROGs-tail, SecReT6, eCIStem, and a divergence-tolerant tail-HMM detector) with a LightGBM classifier comprising 1 multiclass and 3 binary heads, trained on 6,501 bacterial genomes carrying 13,082 prophages and PTEs. A phylogeny-free feature matrix used in our model keeps predictions reproducible between model construction and user inference. PhageTAILor performs strongly at the genome level and generalizes beyond its Pseudomonas-rich training set. On a 76-strain cross-clade benchmark, PhageTAILor detected tailocins at F1 = 0.955. Furthermore, it identified 12 of 13 experimentally validated tailocins spanning five genera versus 2 of 13 for a Pseudomonas-restricted tool TattleTail. PhageTAILor also demonstrated sensitivity equivalent to viral detection tool geNomad while avoiding its higher false-positive rate. Applied to 7,925 plant- and soil-associated bacterial isolates, PhageTAILor showed that prophages in the phyllosphere and tailocins in plant-associated bacteria, whereas eCIS are enriched in soil. PhageTAILor is distributed as an open-source, modular pipeline with a command-line interface.
items.summary_zh: PhageTAILor联合六类候选搜索器和LightGBM，检测并分类植物相关细菌中的噬菌体尾样元件。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 训练数据、跨支系基准和开源模块化流程共同支持其在微生物生态基因组学中的可复现使用。
items.abstract_zh: 噬菌体尾样元件（PTEs）——tailocins、细菌type VI secretion systems（T6SS）和extracellular contractile injection systems（eCIS）——是细菌用来杀死邻居并在微生态系统中竞争的收缩性纳米机器。PTEs有助于塑造微生物群落组成。大多数PTE检测工具只检测一种PTE类别；此外，大多数tailocin检测方法主要限于Pseudomonas，使tailocin多样性的关键部分未被表征。本工作提出PhageTAILor（https://github.com/hjcho-bio/PhageTAILor）：一个整合式、全自动流程，可从细菌基因组中检测和分类prophages及3类PTE。PhageTAILor将由6个检测器构成的基于同源性的候选搜索（geNomad、tail-gene、PHROGs-tail、SecReT6、eCIStem和耐受序列分化的tail-HMM检测器）与LightGBM分类器结合；后者由1个多类别头和3个二元头组成，在携带13,082个prophages和PTE的6,501个细菌基因组上训练。模型使用的无系统发育特征矩阵使模型构建与用户推断之间的预测保持可复现。PhageTAILor在基因组层面表现强劲，并能泛化至其以Pseudomonas为主的训练集之外。在76株跨支系基准上，PhageTAILor检测tailocins的F1 = 0.955。此外，它在跨五个属的13个经实验验证tailocins中识别出12个，而受限于Pseudomonas的工具TattleTail只识别出2个。PhageTAILor还显示出与病毒检测工具geNomad相当的敏感度，同时避免其较高的假阳性率。应用于7,925株植物和土壤相关细菌分离株后，PhageTAILor显示：叶际中的prophages以及植物相关细菌中的tailocins富集，而eCIS在土壤中富集。PhageTAILor作为开源、模块化的命令行流程发布。
